It constructs a bounded self-adjoint tuple $X$ in a von Neumann algebra with a faithful normal tracial state such that $-\infty<\chi(X)\le\chi^*(X)-1/2<\infty$. Here $\chi$ is the microstates entropy with an operator-norm cutoff and a limsup over matrix sizes, and $\chi^*$ is the nonmicrostates entropy defined using free semicircular noise. exact_statement:
theorem main :
    ∃ (H : Type) (_ : NormedAddCommGroup H) (_ : InnerProductSpace ℂ H)
      (_ : CompleteSpace H) (M : VonNeumannAlgebra H) (τ : TracialVector M)
      (n : ℕ) (X S : Fin n → H →L[ℂ] H),
      2 ≤ n ∧
      (∀ i, X i ∈ M ∧ IsSelfAdjoint (X i)) ∧
      (∀ i, S i ∈ M ∧ IsSelfAdjoint (S i)) ∧
      FreeStandardNoise τ X S ∧
      (⊥ : EReal) < chi τ X ∧
      chi τ X ≤ chiStar τ X S - (1 / 2 : EReal) ∧
      chiStar τ X S - (1 / 2 : EReal) < (⊤ : EReal)
